objective: Reduce friction in a creative team local workflow

ideas.title: Substitute ownership
ideas.mechanism: Replace one-time asset ownership with time-bounded access entitlements.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Combine feedback loops
ideas.mechanism: Pair action logs with reversible checkpoints to make feedback replayable.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Invert delivery order
ideas.mechanism: Deliver a removable prototype before committing to its supporting infrastructure.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Remove coordination tolls
ideas.mechanism: Remove per-interaction negotiations by publishing fixed interface commitments.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Serve nonparticipants
ideas.mechanism: Offer a read-only rehearsal route to people excluded by setup requirements.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Unbundle expertise
ideas.mechanism: Separate specialist diagnosis from implementation procurement decisions.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Separate conflicting modes
ideas.mechanism: Resolve precision-versus-speed tension with separate exploration and confirmation paths.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Localize complexity
ideas.mechanism: Confine expensive customization to replaceable boundary modules.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Precondition bottlenecks
ideas.mechanism: Precompute constraint checks before scarce specialist time is reserved.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Immune-style quarantine
ideas.mechanism: Quarantine anomalous inputs and require independent corroboration before reuse.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Mycelial routing
ideas.mechanism: Route a request across redundant local paths according to observed availability.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Dormant resource pools
ideas.mechanism: Keep infrequently needed capabilities dormant until a measured trigger activates them.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Rehearsal quests
ideas.mechanism: Break a high-stakes task into reversible practice challenges with explicit completion evidence.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Asymmetric collaboration
ideas.mechanism: Give collaborators complementary information so joint reconciliation creates the result.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Failure budget play
ideas.mechanism: Allocate a fixed number of safe failed trials before escalation to human review.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Recovery concierge
ideas.mechanism: Preserve context after a failure and offer the smallest recoverable next action.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Reciprocal continuity
ideas.mechanism: Exchange voluntary continuity preferences for fewer repeated setup decisions.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Quiet service lane
ideas.mechanism: Reserve an interruption-free path with deferred nonessential notifications.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Trigger-bound assistance
ideas.mechanism: Activate assistance at the observable moment an unmet job appears.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Outcome escrow
ideas.mechanism: Hold completion claims until the recipient checks the purchased outcome.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Switching rehearsal
ideas.mechanism: Let people test migration with disposable copies before changing their actual workflow.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Ratchet commitments
ideas.mechanism: Advance through one-way documented commitments only after a reversible rehearsal.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Flywheel batching
ideas.mechanism: Accumulate small compatible requests and discharge them as one bounded batch.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Mechanical fuse
ideas.mechanism: Interrupt a process automatically when independently measured load crosses a limit.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: No central catalogue
ideas.mechanism: Discover available capacity from expiring local declarations instead of a global catalogue.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Unadvertised demand
ideas.mechanism: Collect opt-in problem diaries before describing possible offerings.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Deliberate subtraction
ideas.mechanism: Remove the most popular feature in a reversible sandbox to expose hidden dependencies.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Interoperability dividends
ideas.mechanism: Return reusable compatibility fixes to participants who expose shared integration failures.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Congestion feedback
ideas.mechanism: Reduce admission as shared congestion rises rather than maximizing concurrent requests.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Mutual audit rings
ideas.mechanism: Rotate independent reviewers across isolated projects without transferring private inputs.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Executable uncertainty
ideas.mechanism: Attach machine-readable unknowns to proposals so later evidence can invalidate them.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Counterexample memory
ideas.mechanism: Retrieve previous disconfirmations before proposing another similar solution.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Evidence compilation
ideas.mechanism: Compile source-bound claims into a draft that refuses unsupported release statements.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Lift setup constraint
ideas.mechanism: Replace mandatory installation with a disposable local demonstration.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

ideas.title: Lift simultaneity
ideas.mechanism: Replace synchronous attendance with versioned contributions and explicit reconciliation.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

hybrids.title: Replayable quarantine
hybrids.mechanism: Quarantine a suspect action, rehearse its recorded inverse, and use replay differences as corroboration.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

hybrids.title: Precision circuit breaker
hybrids.mechanism: Switch exploration to confirmation mode at a measured load threshold before a scarce-resource queue saturates.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

hybrids.title: Counterexample concierge
hybrids.mechanism: Recover a failed task by retrieving a matched disconfirmation and proposing a reversible context-preserving trial.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

hybrids.title: Independent outcome escrow
hybrids.mechanism: Withhold completion credit until a rotating independent reviewer checks the recipient's outcome evidence.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

meta_hybrids.title: Evidence-clearing coordination
meta_hybrids.mechanism: Coordinate quarantined reversals through independent outcome escrow; only corroborated recovery evidence unlocks the next participant.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.

meta_hybrids.title: Adaptive recovery architecture
meta_hybrids.mechanism: Use load-triggered precision lanes to schedule counterexample-guided recovery, recycling trial failures as future admission constraints.
assumptions: Fixture mechanism is applicable to the brief; this is unverified.
